dataclass Artifact
  digest: str
  size: int
const CREDENTIAL_GUARANTEES
dataclass Constraints
  network: Network | None
const DOWNSTREAM_RECOVERY_GUARANTEES
const NETWORK_COST_GUARANTEES
enum Network
  ANY = 'any'
  UNMETERED = 'unmetered'
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
dataclass Request
  artifact: Artifact
  sources: list[Source]
  constraints: Constraints | None
dataclass Source
  scheme: str
  locator: str
  credential: str
const WAITING_EXTENSIONS
def decode(data)
def decode_artifact(data)
def decode_constraints(data)
def decode_request(data)
def decode_source(data)
def encode(v)
def encode_artifact(v)
def encode_constraints(v)
def encode_request(v)
def encode_source(v)
